title: Check Ignition Gateway system performance status via Ignition Gateway UI (sys.perf)
summary: Use the Ignition Gateway web UI to open the system performance status page (/web/status/sys.perf) and confirm the page is reachable and loads successfully so support can assess Ignition Gateway health/performance.
when_to_use: When you need to verify whether the Ignition Gateway is reachable and whether its system performance status page loads successfully (sys.perf), to support gateway health/performance assessment.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the sys.perf page reachability/load check and report the observed browser failure symptom if the page does not load.
safety_notes: Do not attempt administrative recovery actions from this procedure; use escalation for deeper Ignition Gateway health troubleshooting.
access_or_tools_needed: Web browser access to the Ignition host

access_required: L1_support access to the Ignition host web UI (browser access)
system_preconditions: Ignition Gateway is expected to be reachable from the Ignition host at the provided localhost URL.

visual_references.description: Training frame showing Ignition Gateway UI access via a web browser and the URL containing http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.

steps.title: Open the Ignition Gateway sys.perf status page in a browser
steps.purpose: Establish whether the Ignition Gateway system performance status page is reachable and can be opened.
steps.instruction: On the Ignition host, open a web browser and navigate to http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.
steps.expected_result: The browser navigates to the /web/status/sys.perf page (no browser error preventing page load).
steps.healthy_condition: The sys.perf page loads in the browser without an error.
steps.failure_condition: The sys.perf page does not load due to an unreachable/connection failure (browser error).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the page does not load (gateway down/unresponsive), stop and escalate for Ignition Gateway health troubleshooting.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR text indicates Ignition Gateway UI is accessible through a web browser and shows URL beginning with http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.
Frame OCR: 'Ignition Gateway UI' and 'Ignition can be accessed through the web browser' with URL containing http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf.

steps.title: Confirm sys.perf page content corresponds to a system performance/status view
steps.purpose: Verify that the loaded page is the expected system performance/status view (sys.perf), not a generic error page.
steps.instruction: After the page loads, confirm the content corresponds to a system performance/status view for sys.perf.
steps.expected_result: The sys.perf page loads successfully and displays a system performance/status view.
steps.healthy_condition: The loaded page is clearly the sys.perf system performance/status view.
steps.failure_condition: The page loads into an error/unreachable state or does not present a system performance/status view.

actions.label: Verify sys.perf view
actions.exact_action: Confirm the content corresponds to a system performance/status view (sys.perf).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the page does not load or does not present the expected sys.perf performance/status view, escalate for Ignition Gateway health troubleshooting.

source_evidence.evidence: Packet states the sys.perf page is a system performance/status view and the check is to confirm the page loads and corresponds to that view.

steps.title: If sys.perf is unreachable, record the failure symptom and escalate
steps.purpose: Capture the exact failure symptom to support faster gateway health troubleshooting and avoid unsupported recovery actions.
steps.instruction: If the sys.perf page does not load, note the exact browser failure symptom (for example, connection refused/unreachable) and stop; escalate for Ignition Gateway health troubleshooting.
steps.expected_result: You have an exact failure symptom description from the browser error state and you stop further actions in this procedure.
steps.healthy_condition: Not applicable when the page loads successfully.
steps.failure_condition: No failure symptom is recorded, or you proceed with administrative recovery actions in this procedure.

actions.label: Record browser failure symptom
actions.exact_action: Note the exact failure symptom (e.g., connection refused/unreachable).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the sys.perf page is unreachable or fails to load (gateway down/unresponsive).

source_evidence.evidence: Packet failure_or_escalation_notes: escalate if sys.perf is unreachable/fails to load; do not attempt administrative recovery actions; note exact failure symptom (e.g., connection refused/unreachable).

success_criteria: http://localhost:8088/web/status/sys.perf loads successfully in the browser
The loaded page presents a system performance/status view (sys.perf)
healthy_conditions: sys.perf page loads without browser error and shows a system performance/status view
failure_conditions: sys.perf page is unreachable or fails to load (gateway down/unresponsive)
sys.perf page does not present a system performance/status view
escalation_guidance: Escalate for Ignition Gateway health troubleshooting when the sys.perf page is unreachable/unresponsive or does not load successfully.
